text: Credential CRD_000777 was issued in Turkey, while its holder's 89 claims all occurred in India and Thailand. This is the highest-volume entry in the jurisdiction family, and volume is the one reason to give it a second glance even though the two-country spread itself is honest-range. No revocation or shared-number signal attaches. A large, established corridor practice fits the data. Next step: confirm the Turkish issuance is recognised in India and Thailand; volume makes that worth five minutes.
